characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model's Offensive Skill and Defensive Skill are set to twice the model's current number of Health Points.
The model counts as a Character for the purpose of issuing, accepting, and refusing Duels. When the model fights a Duel during a Round of Combat, it gains Stubborn until the end of the Round of Combat.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Special Attack

For each Fortitude Save the model fails against Melee Attacks, the model immediately inflicts 1 hit with Toxic Attacks against the model that caused the wound, before any casualties are removed, distributed onto the model's Health Pool.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains One of a Kind, +1 Health Point, Vanguard, and Aegis (+1, against Ranged Attacks).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Special Attack

The model gains Grind Attacks (X), and can make Grind Attacks as Supporting Attacks, ignoring the maximum number of Supporting Attacks. When the model is not Engaged in Combat, X is set to 1.At the start of each Round of Combat other than the First Round of Combat, if the model is Engaged, X is increased by +1 (e.g. Grind Attacks (1) becomes Grind Attacks (2)).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Artillery Weapon

Volley Gun. Range 18", Shots 2D6×2, Str~4, AP~1.
Before rolling for the number of shots, the owner may choose to discard 1--3 Veil Tokens from their Veil Token pool. If so, the number of shots is increased by +3 per discarded Veil Token.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Shooting Weapon

Range 24", Shots 1, Str 5, AP 0, Reload!, Volley Fire.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The Standard Bearer can cast the spell stated in brackets as a Bound Spell with Power Level (5/8).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The number of chosen units for Objects of Envy is increased by 1.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains +1 Health Point. The model may perform Make Way moves even when it is in base contact with an enemy model. The unit entry's Duplication Limit is changed to 0-2 Units/Army, and the General of an army with one or more models with Exalted of Envy must take Exalted of Envy.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Attack Attribute -- Close Combat

The model can perform up to 3 Supporting Attacks. When determining Combat Score, a side with at least one model with Spell Craving Engaged in Combat adds +X to its side's Combat Score, where X is the number of non-Bound non-Attribute Spells known by enemy Wizards in units in base contact with it (note that multiple instances of the same spell count as 1 each).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model follows the rules for Ambush with the following exceptions:
When the unit arrives, the owner may choose to place it within 6" of an enemy model with Channel (instead of entering the Battlefield from the Board Edge). If so, it cannot perform any Advance Moves this Movement Phase (note that this does not prevent the unit from performing a Reform).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Maximized (Stomp Attacks), One of a Kind, and +1 Health Point.In addition, replace the rules of Devour with (changes from original version in bold):For each Health Point loss the model causes with Close Combat Attacks against enemy units, roll a D6 at the end of the Initiative Step. For each rolled 4+, the model gains +1 Health Point. When the model has 20 Health Points or more, all units within 12" immediately suffer 2D6 hits with Toxic Attacks, and the model is removed as a casualty.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains One of a Kind and +1 Health Point. In addition, all Weapon Enchantments are ignored for as long as their bearers remain in base contact with the model.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains One of a Kind and +1 Health Point. The rolls for determining the model's Attack Value and Offensive Skill are subject to Maximised Roll.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains One of a Kind and +1 Health Point. In addition, instead of selecting spells, the model knows all spells from its chosen Path. A single Learned Spell may be exchanged for the Hereditary Spell during Spell Selection.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

Units composed entirely of models with Elusive may declare a Flee Charge Reaction despite being Fearless.

characteristics.name: Rule

  • Its base size is changed to 100×100mm.
  • Its Health Points are set to 6.
  • It gains 1 additional Tiller.
  • It gains 1 additional Draft Beast.
  • It gains Colossal Stature.
  • The Chassis gains Impact Hits (3D3).

characteristics.name: Rule

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model's unit must reroll natural to-hit rolls of ‘1’ against Objects of Envy.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model's unit gains Frenzy. In addition,
the model's unit must reroll natural to-wound rolls of ‘1’ with its Melee Attacks, including Special Attacks.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: For every 3 Sin Tokens currently in the Sin Token pool, the model's unit gains +1 Defensive Skill.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model's unit gains Strider. In addition, the model's unit must reroll failed Charge Range rolls in the Charge Phase while located in the Charged unit's Flank or Rear Arc.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model's unit may reroll failed Discipline Tests.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: In the Charge Phase, enemy units gain Minimised (Charge Range) for Charges against units with one or more models with Dominion of Sloth.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model's unit gains Devastating Charge (+1" Adv).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Dominant.
The model and each R&F model in its unit gains Strider.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains +1 Health Point, up to a maximum of 3, and +1 Attack Value.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Dominant.
The model and each R&F model in its unit gains Fortitude (5+). For every natural roll of ‘6’ for a Fortitude Save from the model and each R&F model in its unit, the model's Health Pool Raises one Health Point at the end of the phase.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model loses Swiftstride and gains an effect depending on its Height:

  • Standard: Stomp Attacks (1)

  • Large: Stomp Attacks (2)

  • Gigantic: Grind Attacks (D3). Hits from these Grind Attacks that are distributed onto models with Towering Presence automatically fail to wound.

characteristics.$text:
Dominant.
The model and each R&F model in its unit gains Distracting in the first Round of Combat, Elusive (see Sirens), and Feigned Flight.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Dominant.
The model and each R&F model in its unit gains Devastating Charge (+1 Att, +1 AP).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Ambush. At step 8 of the Pre-Game Sequence (after Spell Selection), each Character with Covetous Camouflage may choose to gain Hidden instead. Additional models cannot be added to the unit during Army List creation.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: When calculating Combat Score, a side with one or more models with this Manifestation Engaged in the Combat adds +X to its Combat Score. When the model is not Engaged in Combat, X is set to 0. At the start of each Round of Combat other than the First Round of Combat, if the model is Engaged, X is increased by 1. If there is more than one unit with this Manifestation Engaged in the same Combat, use the highest X value.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model gains Stubborn while both the following conditions are met:

  • The model is in base contact with an enemy Scoring unit.

  • The model's unit does not have more ranks than files.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Dominant.
The model and each R&F model in its unit gains +2 Armour, up to a maximum of 3.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: While Engaged in Combat, at the end of each Round of Combat, the model’s unit and all other units in base contact with one or more models with this Manifestation suffer -1 Strength and -1 Armour Penetration. The effects last until the end of the combat.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: If the bearer is not a Wizard, it becomes a Wizard Apprentice that does not select spells as normal but instead always knows Spear of Infinity (Hereditary Spell). If the bearer is already a Wizard, it knows Spear of Infinity in addition to its other spells and cannot select it during Spell Selection. In addition, Evil Eye (Witchcraft) becomes the Attribute Spell for Spear of Infinity cast by the model. This instance of Evil Eye can only target the same unit as the Spell that triggered it.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Dominant.
Model parts without Harnessed of the model and of each R&F model in its unit gain Lethal Strike.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: When a R&F model with this Manifestation is removed as a casualty as a result of an enemy Melee Attack, it immediately inflicts 1 hit with Strength 3, Armour Penetration 1, and Magical Attacks against the model that caused the Health Point loss, before any casualties are removed, distributed onto the model’s Health Pool. Characters inflict 2D6 hits instead. This is considered a Special Attack.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Dominant.
The model and each R&F model in its unit gains +1 Attack Value.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
For Army List creation, select one of the seven Legions of Sin. Only unit entries from the selected Legion of Sin may be used in the army. Note that some unit entries may have point costs, duplication limits, Manifestation options, mount options, etc. that differ from the Daemon Legions (DL) Army Book (see 8.D How to read unit entries for the different parts of the unit entries):


  • Each Legion of Sin has access to unique manifestations, whose rules can be found at the beginning of the corresponding chapter in this Supplement.
  • For all unit entries, apply the specifications in their headers in this Supplement Army Book.
  • For the unit profiles, i.e. the units' Characteristic Profiles and Model Rules, including any default and optional unit-specific Model Rules from the DL Army Book, please refer to the DL Army Book. For the Harbinger of each Legion of Sin, please refer to the Harbinger of Father Chaos unit entry.
  • The options given for each unit entry in this Supplement Army Book replace any options given for the corresponding unit entry in the DL Army Book.
  • The Harbinger of each Legion of Sin automatically gains a new Model Rule, and the other Characters gain new optional Model Rules. These Model Rules will be specified in the corresponding unit entry in this Supplement Army Book.
  • Characters cannot take Greater Dominion. Instead, the General must take Greater Dominion of Sin if available (see the Army Model Rules section and the corresponding unit entries).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: During the enemy Siphon the Veil, the opponent may choose to gain up to 2 additional Veil Tokens.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
An army from this Supplement Army Book uses a Sin Token pool in order to track the Battlefield’s Descent into Sin. At the start of the game, this pool does not contain any Sin Tokens. During the game, specific events will add Sin Tokens to the pool.
Consult the Descent into Sin Table below to determine the effects of the current number of Sin Tokens in the pool. These effects come into play when both of the following conditions are met:


  • The corresponding threshold has been reached.

  • It is the Legion of Sin Player Turn.

In battles between two armies from this Supplement Army Book, track each pool separately.
\
Effects from different thresholds and pools stack and, unless specifically stated otherwise, affect both armies.
\Add one Sin Token to your pool immediately when one of the following conditions is met:

  • The opponent chooses to apply Wages of Sin.
  • At the start of any Melee Phase, one or more friendly Characters with Dominion and/or Greater Dominion of Sin are in base contact with an enemy unit.

In addition, each Legion of Sin has a unique condition for adding Sin Tokens to their Sin Token pool:

  • Envy:
Add 1 Sin Token at the end of a phase in which one or more models with Dominion of Envy cause one or more Health Point losses against an Object of Envy; if one or more units containing Objects of Envy are removed as casualties, add 1 additional Sin Token.

  • Gluttony: Add 2 Sin Tokens at the end of any Melee Phase in which one or more units have been removed as casualties.
  • Greed: Add 1 Sin Token at the end of Siphon the Veil if the Active Player saved 3-5 Veil Tokens;
if 6 Veil Tokens were saved, add 2 Sin Tokens instead.
  • Lust: Add 1 Sin Token at the start of any Melee Phase for each unit that is Engaged with the Flank Facing of an enemy unit,
and 2 Sin Tokens for each unit that is Engaged with the Rear Facing of an enemy unit.
  • Pride: Add 1 Sin Token at the start of the Melee Phase for each combat in which one or more friendly single model units are Engaged with at least one enemy unit with more Full Ranks than themselves, up to a maximum of 2.

  • Sloth: Add 1 Sin Token at the end of any Magic Phase in which at least two non-Attribute Spells were successfully cast; in case of three or more, add 2 Sin Tokens instead.
  • Wrath: Add 1 Sin Token at the end of any Charge Phase in which two units declared a Charge;
if three or more units declared a Charge, add 2 Sin Tokens instead.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Units with at least one model with this Favour gain Minimised (Discipline Tests).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The first time a model with this Favour is on the winning side of a combat, its model parts with this Favour gain +1 Strength until the end of the game. The Strength bonus from this Favour also affects the model parts’ attacks with Spiked Shields .

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Units with more than half of their models with this Favour are subject to the following rules:
  • They gain Feigned Flight.
  • They may declare Flee as a Charge Reaction even if they have Fearless.
  • Their Rally Test in their next Player Turn after voluntarily declaring Flee as a Charge Reaction is subject to Minimised Roll. This does not apply if a unit fails to rally on the next friendly Player Turn or Flees involuntarily.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Units with more than half of their models with this Favour gain Maximised (Charge Range, Pursuit Distance, Overrun Distance).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model part gains Great Weapon, Halberd, Paired Weapons, and Weapon Master. The Special Item allowance of Characters with this Favour is increased by 50 pts.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Attacks against the model suffer -1 to wound. When the model's unit declares a Charge or performs a March Move, the effect is lost until the start of the Melee Phase in the next Player Turn.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model part gains Lightning Reflexes in the First Round of Combat.
